provenance.sourceName: Century GDD v2.0 §15.3 provisional world anchors plus a stylized transition
provenance.notes: Synthetic, not a source-backed historical demographic series. The 1900-1949 mortality schedule is held flat and steps down in 1950 to exercise a stylized transition. Age-specific rates are provisional reconstructions. The crude birth-rate anchors were adjusted by +0.3 per 1,000 from the earlier provisional values to reduce the error against the source-backed OWID world-population curve; this is a calibration adjustment to a total-population target, not evidence that the age-specific schedules are historical.
